title: US Intel Says the Woman Next to Jensen Huang Was a Chinese Spy #shorts
desc: A bar bet at Computex 2024. Two years later, according to the New York Times, US intelligence concluded she was working for China's Ministry of State Security. And nobody warned him.

title: 2 Employees. $2 Billion of Nvidia Chips. #shorts
desc: Who is Alice Huang? According to the New York Times and the Financial Times, her company Megaspeed moved about two billion dollars of Nvidia's most advanced chips, from an office with two employees.

title: Look Who's Standing Right Behind Jensen Huang #shorts
desc: Computex 2025. Jensen Huang stops for the cameras, and the woman right behind him is Alice Huang. As reported by the New York Times.

title: Nvidia's CEO Cleaned Toilets at a Reform School #shorts
desc: Kentucky, 1973. A nine-year-old Jensen Huang is sent to what his parents think is a boarding school. It isn't.

title: Nvidia Started in a Denny's Booth With $600 #shorts
desc: Three engineers, a booth at a Denny's in San Jose, and two hundred dollars each. Then the first chip flops.

title: The $5 Trillion Company China Isn't Allowed to Buy From #shorts
desc: Nvidia became the first company ever worth five trillion dollars. One country wants its chips more than almost anyone, and it isn't allowed to buy them.

title: Washington Takes 15% of Nvidia's China Sales #shorts
desc: The chip war in under a minute: export rules, a 4.5 billion dollar write-off, and the deal that brought the licences back.

title: The Hole in America's Chip Wall #shorts
desc: The rules stop chips going into China. They don't stop a Chinese company renting them somewhere else. That's the business Megaspeed is in, according to reports.

title: How China's Spies Recruit You #shorts
desc: China's Ministry of State Security, and the real case of a GE Aviation engineer who went to the FBI.

title: Code Name: Parlor Maid #shorts
desc: Katrina Leung, Christine Fang and Eric Swalwell: the real spy romance cases, as reported by prosecutors and the press.

title: They Hid His Name. Then They Looked. #shorts
desc: US intelligence hides the names of Americans under a black bar. According to the New York Times, in Alice Huang's file, officials asked to see it. It was Jensen Huang.

title: What China Wanted From Jensen Huang #shorts
desc: Not his chip designs, according to the New York Times. And now nobody knows where Alice Huang is.

title: Trump Was Told. He Took No Action. #shorts
desc: According to the New York Times, Trump was told about the surveillance of Alice Huang. Then came the H200 approval, the Beijing trip and a National Medal of Science. And nobody warned Jensen.

title: The Story That Wiped 4% Off Nvidia #shorts
desc: The New York Times breaks the story. Nvidia's stock falls more than four percent, and Washington, Beijing and Nvidia all blame someone else.

title: Jensen Huang: 'I Was Unfaithful to My Wife' #shorts
desc: Nvidia posts an email from Jensen Huang to every employee. The board opens an investigation and backs him to stay.
